## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as she gives birth to a newborn girl named Joyce, but the baby tragically passes away later that evening. Friends and family offer comfort and prepare the baby for burial, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grieves deeply and struggles to find meaning or comfort in her sorrow.
